title: Trade school / certification program research
description: Check accreditation and licensing eligibility and analyze cost and job placement for candidate vocational or certification programs.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: trade-school-research
  title: Trade school / certification program research
  description: Check accreditation and licensing eligibility and analyze cost and job placement for candidate vocational or certification programs.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Produce a scored comparison of candidate trade or certification programs covering accreditation validity, licensing eligibility, and cost/outcomes.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 2
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor: []
  nodes:
    - id: candidate-programs
      kind: input
      name: Candidate trade programs and constraints
      summary: The candidate programs, budget, and location constraints.
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [text]
        properties:
          text: { type: string, description: "The candidate trade or certification programs, budget, and location constraints." }
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: accreditation-licensing-checker
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Accreditation and licensing checker
      summary: Checks accreditation status and licensing-exam eligibility.
      role: Vocational accreditation and licensing researcher
      prompt: Check whether each candidate program is properly accredited and whether its certificate qualifies graduates for the relevant state licensing exam or credential. Describe which accreditation databases and state licensing board pages to check rather than asserting unverified accreditation status. This is not legal advice, and the family should confirm licensing requirements directly with the state licensing board.
      capabilities: { skills: [research], tools: [read, search], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: job-placement-cost-analyst
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Job placement and cost analyst
      summary: Researches tuition, time to completion, and placement outcomes.
      role: Program cost and job-placement researcher
      prompt: Research each program's published tuition, fees, typical time to completion, and job-placement or outcomes statistics. Describe what official disclosures to check, such as gainful-employment disclosures and placement reports, rather than inventing figures. This is not financial advice, and the family should confirm actual costs and outcomes with the school's admissions office.
      capabilities: { skills: [finance-analysis], tools: [read, search], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: parallel-check-group
      kind: group
      name: Parallel accreditation and cost check
      summary: Runs the accreditation and cost/placement checks side by side.
      config: { members: [accreditation-licensing-checker, job-placement-cost-analyst], execution: parallel, exit: aggregate }
    - id: collect-findings
      kind: aggregator
      name: Collect findings
      summary: Collects both analysts' findings for scoring.
      config: { aggregation: collect }
    - id: score-program-viability
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Score program viability
      summary: Scores each program on accreditation, licensing, and cost reasonableness.
      role: Independent program-viability evaluator
      prompt: Evaluate the collected findings for each program and return a score, pass/fail, and reasons covering accreditation validity, licensing eligibility, and cost or outcome reasonableness. This is advisory research support only and not a guarantee of licensure or employment outcomes.
      capabilities: { skills: [evaluation], tools: [read], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object, required: [score, passed, reasons], properties: { score: { type: number }, passed: { type: boolean }, reasons: { type: array, items: { type: string } } } }
      config: { threshold: 0.7 }
    - id: program-comparison-output
      kind: output
      name: Trade program comparison summary
      summary: The scored comparison across candidate programs.
  edges:
    - { id: e1, from: candidate-programs, to: parallel-check-group, kind: data }
    - { id: e2, from: parallel-check-group, to: collect-findings, kind: data }
    - { id: e3, from: collect-findings, to: score-program-viability, kind: data }
    - { id: e4, from: score-program-viability, to: program-comparison-output, kind: data }
